'''Sedrundra''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], who committed terrible crimes during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was captured by the Republic along with 49 dangerous criminals. While been guarded by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the cruiser was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The cruiser's main reactor was damaged, causing the cells to open and the prisoners who therefore can attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. While the Jedi were trying to hold the prisoners, the crew tried to repair the reactor until they ultimately failed. Sedrundra was among the prisoners to cooperate with the Jedi and helped repair the ship, allowing it to move safely through Republic space. Skywalker thanked the prisoners for helping and guaranteed their aid will affect their parole.
